title: Test the PDF Function's render on the staging preview; locally wrangler only proves routing, caching and errors
body:
Working on the CV does not need the Function: `pnpm run dev` serves `/cv` and `pnpm run pdf:local` prints with Playwright. Only for `functions/**`:
1. `cp .dev.vars.example .dev.vars` and fill both values.
2. `pnpm run build`
3. `pnpm dlx wrangler pages dev dist` (dlx: wrangler is NOT a repo dependency; `.dev.vars.example` says `pnpm exec`, which fails) -> http://localhost:8788/cv.pdf
Browser Rendering will try to print `http://localhost:8788/cv`, unreachable from Cloudflare's cloud, so locally you verify routing, caching and error handling, NOT the render. The render is tested on the `staging` preview (staging.cribbnicolas.pages.dev/cv.pdf), and the smoke (`smoke-deploy.yml`) is the end-to-end test. A tunnel was considered and rejected as infra for a one-minute preview.
not_derivable: That the render cannot be tested locally, and that a tunnel was rejected in favour of the staging preview, is not written in code.

evidence.summary: Local vars template; its wrangler command says `pnpm exec`.
Tests the published PDF after each staging/main deploy.
